email.richTextBody:
Koko's Forest - EP060

The Mountain Climb 爬山大作戰

合作 · Teamwork

Learning words
MOUNTAIN - MOUNTAIN
MOUNTAIN 山 TOP 山頂 TOGETHER 一起
Practice MOUNTAIN together.

TOP - TOP
MOUNTAIN 山 TOP 山頂 TOGETHER 一起
Practice TOP together.

TOGETHER - TOGETHER
MOUNTAIN 山 TOP 山頂 TOGETHER 一起
Practice TOGETHER together.

Parent activity
每日任務 Daily Mission 今天試著用 'MOUNTAIN' 說一個句子! Try saying a sentence with 'MOUNTAIN' today! 角色扮演 Role Play 和家人一起演一演這集的故事! Act out today's story with your family! Tip: Together, every mountain becomes smaller.... 小測驗 Quick Quiz What does 'MOUNTAIN' mean? / 'MOUNTAIN' 是什麼意思? A. 山 B. 高興 happy C. 跑步 run D. 睡覺 sleep
